title: Qwen Ultra Deep reasoning
items: Deep is now the default for new Ultra requests: a draft, a separate critique, then the final answer. Standard remains available for faster replies.
Progress shows Drafting, Reviewing and Writing final answer. The draft and critique are kept out of the conversation; the final answer is saved as it streams.
Each stage has a bounded thinking budget and uses the original prepared evidence. A partial review is labelled, and failed reviews never silently become completed answers.
The same model reviews its own draft, so improved accuracy is possible but not guaranteed. Deep does not add web search or code execution.
Update FUPCJ Server with Update-Venture.ps1, then refresh Vision. Existing Ultra models and verified context settings are reused.
